elements.name: TextBox 146
elements.text: Retooling begins with a simple recognition: the people doing the work may remain the same even when the methods around them must change. Tools can be physical, technical, social, or cultural. Join voices across disciplines to ask what deserves to be kept, what needs to be rebuilt, and what communities can create next.
